description: Create a new outpatient clinical encounter for patient David Okonkwo in OpenClinic GA. Log in with username '4' and password 'openclinic'. The application is at http://localhost:10088/openclinic. Search for patient 'DAVID OKONKWO' (ID 10004) using the patient search. Open his clinical record, navigate to the Encounters section, and create a new outpatient encounter for today. Set the encounter/visit type to 'Outpatient' or 'Ambulatory'. In the diagnosis/RFE (Reason for Encounter) field, enter ICD-10 code J06.9 (Acute upper respiratory infection, unspecified). Save the encounter.
